sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形。我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: New Year's Eve is just around the corner, and whether you love it or hate it,
sentences.zh: 除夕夜就在眼前，不管你是爱它还是恨它，

sentences.en: you are probably putting more thought into what you'll be doing that night than any other night of the year.
sentences.zh: 你对那天晚上要做什么的思考，可能比一年中任何其他晚上都要多。

sentences.en: I'm not much of a New Year's Eve person myself.
sentences.zh: 我本人并不是一个热衷于过除夕夜的人。

sentences.en: But there's just too much pressure on New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 但除夕夜的压力实在太大了。

sentences.en: You want me to set the tone for my whole year in one night of obligatory fun?
sentences.zh: 你想让我用一个充满义务性狂欢的夜晚，来为我整年的基调定调？

sentences.en: And yet, despite my crankiness, I do have one New Year's guilty pleasure.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管我脾气古怪，我确实有一个除夕夜的罪恶快乐。

sentences.en: Something about it that I do love.
sentences.zh: 有些事情我确实很喜欢。

sentences.en: And it is the most New Year's-y of all New Year's rituals.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是所有除夕仪式中最具除夕特色的一项了。

sentences.en: The massive, confetti-filled extravaganza that is New Year's Eve in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 那就是时代广场充满纸屑、规模宏大的除夕狂欢。

sentences.en: Every year, I see footage of the celebration, and almost despite myself, I end up tearing up.
sentences.zh: 每年，我看到庆祝活动的画面时，几乎身不由己地就会热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: There's all these people piled together, smiling, waving, full of hope for the future.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人挤在一起，微笑着，挥手着，对未来充满希望。

sentences.en: And inexplicably stoked about a glorified disco ball getting slowly impaled on the spit of one Times Square.
sentences.zh: 而且莫名其妙地热衷于看着一个美化过的迪斯科球慢慢被串在时代广场一号大楼的尖顶上。

sentences.en: And then everybody makes out, and Ryan Seacrest is there.
sentences.zh: 然后大家开始热吻，瑞安·西克雷斯特也在那里。

sentences.en: But one of the most iconic parts of the whole celebration happens after the clock strikes midnight and the fireworks go off.
sentences.zh: 但整个庆祝活动中最标志性的环节之一，发生在午夜钟声敲响、烟花绽放之后。

sentences.en: When the massive crowd bursts into New York, New York.
sentences.zh: 当庞大的人群爆发出《纽约，纽约》的歌声时。

sentences.en: I think this is the big reason it hits me so hard, despite not being a New Year's Eve fan.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是它对我触动如此之深的主要原因，尽管我并不是一个除夕夜迷。

sentences.en: It's that Times Square, especially on New Year's, is almost mythologically New York.
sentences.zh: 那就是时代广场，尤其是在除夕夜，几乎具有神话般的纽约色彩。

sentences.en: Times Square is the neighborhood of brilliant signs, skyscrapers, and hot dog carts.
sentences.zh: 时代广场是一个充满巨幅广告牌、摩天大楼和热狗摊的街区。

sentences.en: It's got cavalier office workers breezing past ambling tourists without breaking their important-sounding phone conversations.
sentences.zh: 这里有傲慢的上班族从漫步的游客身边轻快走过，而他们听起来很重要的电话却一刻也没有停过。

sentences.en: Basically, it's a caricature, the movie version of New York.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，它是一个夸张的符号，是电影里的纽约。

sentences.en: Over 100 million people come to Times Square every year to take a bite out of the Big Apple.
sentences.zh: 每年有超过1亿人来到时代广场，想要一尝大苹果的滋味。

sentences.en: And the neighborhood is consistently one of the top tourist destinations in the world.
sentences.zh: 这个街区一直是全球顶级的旅游目的地之一。

sentences.en: But the Times Square we know today didn't just happen.
sentences.zh: 但我们今天所知的时代广场并非凭空出现。

sentences.en: In the late 80s and early 90s, much of the neighborhood was seized by the government and reshaped by a powerful group of business owners.
sentences.zh: 在80年代末和90年代初，该街区的大片土地被政府征收，并被一群强大的商界业主重塑。

sentences.en: It's a transformation that saw a neighborhood emptied out, and it raises questions about how private money should shape public space.
sentences.zh: 这是一场导致街区被清空的转型，它引发了关于私人资金应如何塑造公共空间的疑问。

sentences.en: Land we now call Times Square was, for about 3,000 years, home to the indigenous Lenape people.
sentences.zh: 我们现在称为时代广场的土地，在约3,000年的时间里，一直是当地原住民勒纳佩人的家园。

sentences.en: But since Manhattan was colonized by Europeans, the neighborhood has lived many lives.
sentences.zh: 但自从曼哈顿被欧洲人殖民以来，这个街区经历过许多次生命。

sentences.en: Before it was Times Square, it was a place called Longacre Square, which was a place for the carriage trade, all kinds of livery, stables, and the like.
sentences.zh: 在成为时代广场之前，这里曾被称为朗格克广场，是一个从事马车贸易、各种出租马车、马厩及类似行业的地方。

sentences.en: This is Lynn Segalen, a professor emerita at Columbia Business School, who has written books on the many faces of Times Square.
sentences.zh: 这是哥伦比亚商学院的荣誉退休教授林恩·西加伦，她曾撰写过关于时代广场多面性的书籍。

sentences.en: She says that in the late 19th century, Longacre Square was the part of town with more horses than people, situated just north of the more bustling parts of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 她说，在19世纪末，朗格克广场是镇上马匹比人还多的地方，位于曼哈顿繁华地区的正北方。

sentences.en: It was in no man's land, okay?
sentences.zh: 这里是三不管地带，对吧？

sentences.en: There barely had streetlights on Broadway at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时百老汇街上几乎连路灯都没有。

sentences.en: But what happened next is exactly what you'd expect.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的事正是你所预料的。

sentences.en: New York kept growing and growing, and speculators, as they do, pulled some of the city's money and energy north onto the cheap land of Longacre Square.
sentences.zh: 纽约不断发展壮大，投机者们像往常一样，将城市的一部分资金和精力向北吸引到了朗格克广场的廉价土地上。

sentences.en: By the early 1900s, a handful of theaters were doing decent business in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪初，少数几家剧院在这个街区做着不错的生意。

sentences.en: Not long after that, a subway stop opened at Longacre, connecting the fledgling area to the rest of the city.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，一个地铁站在朗格克开通，将这个初露头角的地区与城市的其他地方连接起来。

sentences.en: But what really brought the neighborhood into its own was the arrival of its most famous resident.
sentences.zh: 但真正让这个街区大放异彩的，是它最著名的居民的到来。

sentences.en: In 1903, the New York Times broke ground in Longacre Square, and a year later, they petitioned the city for a name change.
sentences.zh: 1903年，《纽约时报》在朗格克广场破土动工，一年后，他们向市政府请愿更改地名。

sentences.en: The neighborhood has been called Times Square ever since.
sentences.zh: 从此这个街区就被称为时代广场。

sentences.en: This was the beginning of a new era for Times Square.
sentences.zh: 这是时代广场新时代的开始。

sentences.en: Thanks to the theaters and the subway and the vote of confidence from the paper of record, the neighborhood was happening.
sentences.zh: 多亏了剧院、地铁以及这家权威大报的信任票，这个街区开始繁荣起来。

sentences.en: In just a few years, it went from a tentatively hip part of town to a thunderous, triumphant hotspot for celebrations, for work, and for nightlife.
sentences.zh: 在短短几年内，它从一个试探性的时尚地段变成了一个震耳欲聋、凯旋归来的庆祝、工作和夜生活热点。

sentences.en: More and more theaters cropped up, turning New York into the country's leading theater city.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的剧院涌现出来，使纽约成为全国领先的戏剧城市。

sentences.en: So it became the most famous theater street in the world.
sentences.zh: 因此它成为了世界上最著名的戏剧街。

sentences.en: There was a lot of nighttime gaiety, and restaurants were on rooftops, because this was an era before you had air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 当时有许多夜间娱乐活动，餐馆都在屋顶上，因为这是一个还没有空调的时代。

sentences.en: And in the summer, it was quite hot.
And so you had a lot of really elegant rooftop palaces where people would go for dinner and drinks.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多非常优雅的屋顶宫殿，人们会去那里吃晚饭和喝酒。

sentences.en: It was during this period of rapid growth that Times Square also got a new tradition.
sentences.zh: 正是在这段迅猛发展的时期，时代广场也迎来了一个新传统。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve in 1907, the Times sponsored the first ball drop to welcome in 1908.
sentences.zh: 在1907年的除夕夜，《纽约时报》赞助了第一次降球仪式以迎接1908年。

sentences.en: The falling ball was paid for by Adolph Ox, then publisher and owner of The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 下落的球由当时的《纽约时报》出版商兼所有者阿道夫·奥克斯出资制作。

sentences.en: Ox borrowed the idea from an old Navy ritual that started in England in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 奥克斯从19世纪在英国兴起的一项旧海军仪式中借用了这个想法。

sentences.en: Every day at 1,300 hours Greenwich Mean Time, a ball would drop on the top of England's Royal Observatory
sentences.zh: 每天格林威治标准时间13点00分，英国皇家天文台的顶端都会落下标配的球

sentences.en: so that sailors could set their clocks and navigation equipment.
sentences.zh: 以便水手们校准时钟和导航设备。

sentences.en: Times Square was the perfect location for a big display like a ball drop.
sentences.zh: 时代广场是举办像降球这样盛大展示的完美地点。

sentences.en: That's because the square lies at a diagonal intersection, unlike most of Manhattan, which is built on a grid.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这个广场位于一个斜向交叉口，不像曼哈顿大部分建立在网格系统上的地方。

sentences.en: Big, wide streets come together at Times Square, creating these long urban vistas.
sentences.zh: 宽阔的大街在时代广场交汇，形成了这些长长的城市景观。

sentences.en: Meaning, from almost anywhere in the neighborhood, you could see the ball.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，从该街区的几乎任何地方，你都能看到这个球。

sentences.en: So in 1907, Ox rigged a ball to the top of one Times Square, where the Times was headquartered.
sentences.zh: 所以在1907年，奥克斯在作为《时报》总部的时代广场一号大楼顶端安装了一个球。

sentences.en: And that was the start of an annual tradition that became the biggest celebration in a neighborhood built for celebrating.
sentences.zh: 这拉开了一项年度传统的序幕，它成为了一个为庆祝而生的街区中最盛大的庆典。

sentences.en: Over the following years, Times Square just kept getting bigger and more glamorous.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，时代广场不断壮大，变得越来越迷人。

sentences.en: But the neighborhood only had a few glorious decades as New York's hottest club.
sentences.zh: 但这个街区作为纽约最热门俱乐部的辉煌岁月只持续了几十年。

sentences.en: Because in 1929, everything changed when the stock market crashed.
sentences.zh: 因为在1929年，股市崩盘改变了一切。

sentences.en: Then you have the crash, and then people don't have as much money to go out.
sentences.zh: 然后股市崩盘了，人们没有那么多钱出去玩了。

sentences.en: And if they do, they're going to movie theaters, going to see motion pictures less expensive than live theater.
sentences.zh: 如果他们出去，他们会去电影院，去看比现场戏剧花费更少的电影。

sentences.en: And then you had the war.
Times Square never really had a chance to recover.
sentences.zh: 时代广场再也没有真正恢复过元气。

sentences.en: With World War II came blackouts and electricity rations that shut off its neon lights.
sentences.zh: 随着二战的到来，灯火管制和电力配给切断了它的霓虹灯。

sentences.en: Then, after the war, people fled to the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 然后，战后人们逃往郊区。

sentences.en: A lot of industry left the area.
And by the late 1940s, the neighborhood's businesses were mainly scraping by on cheap movies and carnival games.
sentences.zh: 到1940年代末，该街区的企业主要靠廉价电影和嘉年华游戏勉强维生。

sentences.en: You have all sorts of rides and games and shooting galleries to win prizes.
sentences.zh: 你有各种各样的游乐设施、游戏和射击场来赢得奖品。
各种马戏团式的娱乐活动。

sentences.en: You had a kind of Coney Island Times Square.
sentences.zh: 你拥有了一个某种意义上的康尼岛版时代广场。

sentences.en: At this point, Times Square was busy, but kind of broke.
sentences.zh: 此时的时代广场虽然热闹，但可以说是破产了。

sentences.en: Property owners needed a way to bring in real money.
sentences.zh: 业主们需要一种方法来引入真金白银。

sentences.en: And carnival games just weren't cutting it.
sentences.zh: 而嘉年华游戏根本不管用。

sentences.en: The problem was that Times Square was built largely as a theater district.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，时代广场在很大程度上是作为戏剧区建造的。

sentences.en: And it was hard to turn a theater into a shoe store, for instance, or a tailor.
sentences.zh: 要把剧院改成鞋店或裁缝铺是很困难的。

sentences.en: There was, however, one type of show that could consistently pull in a crowd.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一种类型的演出能够持续吸引人群。

sentences.en: I can't tell you the exact date that the sex show started, but they were there before the 60s.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你色情秀开始的具体日期，但它们在60年代之前就已经存在了。

sentences.en: There had always been raunchier shows in Times Square, with opera and vaudeville operating side by side.
sentences.zh: 时代广场一直都有比较低俗的演出，歌剧和杂耍同时并存。

sentences.en: But in the mid-20th century, sexy shows like burlesque weren't the exception.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪中期，诸如滑稽戏之类的性感表演已不再是例外。

sentences.en: Smaller shops got in on the action, too, complementing the big theaters.
sentences.zh: 小型商店也加入其中，与大型剧院相辅相成。

sentences.en: So in the back of bookstores, you had the adult books, OK?
sentences.zh: 所以在书店的后面，有成人书籍，对吧？

sentences.en: And in 1966, you had the first peeps, 25-cent peep shows introduced.
sentences.zh: 在1966年，引进了第一批窥视孔表演，即25美分的窥视秀。

sentences.en: And as they would say, 25 cents for a peep machine in a private booth was a rare bargain in an expensive city.
sentences.zh: 正如他们所说，在一个物价昂贵的城市里，在私人包厢里花25美分看一场窥视机表演是一笔难得的便宜买卖。

sentences.en: White-collar workers, mostly male, would trickle in from their offices, disparaging the neighborhood by day while quietly patronizing it at night.
sentences.zh: 白领阶层，大多是男性，从办公室里陆陆续续走出来，白天贬低这个街区，晚上却悄悄光顾。

sentences.en: It was common knowledge what was for sale in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 时代广场出售什么可以说是人尽皆知。

sentences.en: But these transactions were largely taking place out of sight in back rooMs.
sentences.zh: 但这些交易大都在背后的房间里神不知鬼不觉地进行着。

sentences.en: That is, until the early 70s, when a Supreme Court case called Miller v.
sentences.zh: 直到70年代初，最高法院审理了一起名为米勒诉

sentences.en: California really opened up possibilities for smuts in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州案，彻底打开了时代广场黄色废品的发展可能。

sentences.en: The interpretation of obscenity changes, and then it all breaks open.
sentences.zh: 对淫秽的定义发生了变化，然后一切都彻底爆发了。

sentences.en: California, the court basically said that what was obscene depended on local norMs.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州案中，法院基本上指出，什么算淫秽取决于当地的标准。

sentences.en: So in a big coastal city like New York, all bets were off.
sentences.zh: 所以在像纽约这样的大型沿海城市，一切限制都不复存在了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, showing pornography, explicit books, movies, or live shows, was completely legal.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，播放色情内容、露骨的书籍、电影或现场表演完全合法了。

sentences.en: And Times Square stepped onto the scene as the definitive porn capital of New York City.
sentences.zh: 时代广场作为纽约市绝对的色情之都登上了历史舞台。
于是性成为了一种产业。

sentences.en: I mean, you had massage parlors, you had live nude shows, you had peeps, you had topless bars, you had hardcore sex films, you had porn emporiums, you had adult bookstores,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有按摩院，有现场裸体秀，有窥视秀，有无上装酒吧，有硬核色情电影，有成人用品店，有成人书店，

sentences.en: you had, I mean, it was a cornucopia of commercial sex.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个商业化的色情百宝箱。

sentences.en: You had everything you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 你能够想象到的一切这里都有。

sentences.en: The result of all this, the big struggling theaters, the pornography, the sex trade,
sentences.zh: 这一切的结果——苦苦挣扎的大剧院、色情业、性交易，

sentences.en: all of it contributed to a version of Times Square that was a far cry from the glamorous theater district it had once been.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都促成了这样一个时代广场：它与曾经那个光鲜亮丽的戏剧区相去甚远。

sentences.en: By the 70s, Times Square was a gritty, tough place.
sentences.zh: 到了70年代，时代广场是一个肮脏、艰难的地方。

sentences.en: I was a teenager, and for a woman, it was just not a place you wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个青少年，对女性来说，这里根本不是你想呆的地方。

sentences.en: Add to this the fact that New York City nearly went bankrupt in the 1970s and cut back on vital services like sanitation.
sentences.zh: 再加上纽约市在1970年代差点破产，削减了环卫等生死攸关的公共服务。

sentences.en: So it wasn't just dicey, it was divy and a bit dirty.
sentences.zh: 所以它不仅危机四伏，而且破败不堪，还有点脏乱。

sentences.en: Rolling Stone would come to crown a stretch of Times Square, the sleaziest block in America.
sentences.zh: 《滚石》杂志甚至将时代广场的一段评为全美最藏污纳垢的街区。

sentences.en: You had assault, you had battery, you had fights, you know.
sentences.zh: 这里有袭击，有殴打，有斗殴，你知道的。

sentences.en: You basically had a range of activity from minor crime to serious crime, meaning murder and rape, that was part of the territory in those decades.
sentences.zh: 基本上，从轻微犯罪到严重犯罪（包括谋杀和强奸）的各种活动，在那几十年里都是这里的家常便饭。

sentences.en: This was pretty much rock bottom for Times Square, at least according to the government.
sentences.zh: 对于时代广场来说，这几乎是谷底了，至少对政府而言是这样。

sentences.en: By this point, city and state officials saw Times Square as a sort of emblem of the city's decline.
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，市和州的官员将时代广场视为这座城市衰落的某种象征。

sentences.en: The city also saw that it was losing out on tourism dollars.
sentences.zh: 市政府也发现它正在失去旅游收入。

sentences.en: Times Square was no longer a top destination for visitors.
sentences.zh: 时代广场不再是游客的首选目的地。

sentences.en: One indicator, by the late 70s, attendance at the neighborhood's annual New Year's Eve fanfare had dropped by 95% from mid-century.
sentences.zh: 一个指标是，到70年代末，该街区年度除夕狂欢活动的出席人数比世纪中期下降了95%。

sentences.en: This at a time when tourism to the rest of the city was booming.
sentences.zh: 而此时该市其他地区的旅游业却在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: The city was desperate to clean up the neighborhood and convince residents and tourists alike that Times Square was a place worth visiting.
sentences.zh: 市政府迫切希望清理这个街区，并说服居民和游客相信时代广场是一个值得一游的地方。

sentences.en: And it's this desperation that set off a pair of events that would push Times Square out of its seedy past and into its bright, family-friendly future.
sentences.zh: 正是这种绝望情绪引发了一系列事件，将时代广场从肮脏的过去推向了光明、适合家庭的未来。

sentences.en: We're back with reporter Katie Thornton.
sentences.zh: 我们与记者凯蒂·桑顿一起回来了。

sentences.en: By the start of the 80s, New York officials were sick of their once-premier destination for all things glamorous being a laughingstock, a den of vice and danger.
sentences.zh: 到80年代初，纽约官员已经厌倦了他们曾经首屈一指的魅力胜地沦为一个笑柄、一个充满罪恶和危险的巢穴。

sentences.en: So in 1981, they announced a plan to clean up the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 因此在1981年，他们宣布了一项清理该街区的计划。

sentences.en: New York would use eminent domain to condemn much of Times Square.
sentences.zh: 纽约将使用征收权来征用时代广场的大部分土地。

sentences.en: Eminent domain allows the government to seize private land for public use.
sentences.zh: 征收权允许政府为了公共利益征收私有土地。

sentences.en: It has a long history of being used to dispossess black and brown communities.
sentences.zh: 它有着剥夺黑人和棕色人种社区财产的悠久历史。

sentences.en: Owners are compensated for their property, but they don't have any choice but to sell.
sentences.zh: 业主会因其财产得到赔偿，但他们别无选择，只能出售。

sentences.en: In New York, eminent domain had been used before to build Central Park, expand New York's drinking water reservoir, build Lincoln Center.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，征收权以前曾被用来建造中央公园、扩大纽约的饮用水水库、建造林肯中心。

sentences.en: And now the city and state were partnering with private developers to empty out Times Square so it could be filled back up with more desirable businesses.
sentences.zh: 现在，市和州正与私人开发商合作，清空时代广场，以便用更令人向往的商业填满它。

sentences.en: There's a big, significant, complicated, complex plan to change all the uses, to wipe out the bad uses and put in place good uses.
sentences.zh: 这是一个宏大、重要、复杂的计划，旨在改变所有的用途，抹去不良用途，代之以优质用途。

sentences.en: Bad was all the commercial sex and porn, and good uses were office, return of live theater, and other forms of entertainment.
sentences.zh: 不良用途是指所有的商业色情和淫秽内容，优质用途则是指办公室、现场戏剧的回归以及其他形式的娱乐。

sentences.en: Cleaning up the city was a euphemism for a lot of things you probably already know about New York in the 80s and 90s.
sentences.zh: 清理城市是对你可能已经了解的80年代和90年代纽约许多事情的一种委婉说法。

sentences.en: There's urban renewal, Mayor Giuliani, broken windows, policing, and we'll get into that.
sentences.zh: 这里有城市复兴、朱利安尼市长、破窗理论、警务治理，我们接下来会讨论这些。

sentences.en: But in Times Square specifically, the cleanup was also motivated by homophobia.
sentences.zh: 但在时代广场，这种清理也是出于对同性恋的恐惧。

sentences.en: Remember, this was in the middle of the AIDS crisis, and Times Square wasn't just home to the sex industry.
sentences.zh: 记住，这正值艾滋病危机期间，时代广场不仅是色情产业的发源地。

sentences.en: It was also one of the few places in the city with a thriving gay scene.
sentences.zh: 它也是这座城市中为数不多的拥有繁荣同性恋文化的场所之一。

sentences.en: People, straight and queer, made their living in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 异性恋者和酷儿都在时代广场谋生。

sentences.en: They went out, screwed around, fell in love.
sentences.zh: 他们外出，胡闹，坠入爱河。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, it was home.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这里就是家。

sentences.en: But these were not the people that the city and state wanted representing New York.
sentences.zh: 但这些人并不是市政府和州政府希望用来代表纽约的人。

sentences.en: So in 1990, New York condemned multiple blocks of Times Square, kicking out hundreds of businesses, as well as poor and elderly residents.
sentences.zh: 所以在1990年，纽约对时代广场的好几个街区进行了征收，赶走了数百家企业，以及贫困和年长的居民。

sentences.en: At the time, it was the largest redevelopment project in the country.
sentences.zh: 当时，这是全国最大的重建项目。

sentences.en: But around the same time the plan went into effect, the real estate market tanked.
sentences.zh: 但就在该计划生效前后，房地产市场崩溃了。

sentences.en: Some tenants who had promised to move in pulled out, and other prospective buyers weren't biting.
sentences.zh: 一些承诺搬进来的租户退出了，其他潜在买家也不买账。

sentences.en: Much of Times Square was emptied out, but there were very few businesses willing to fill it back up.
sentences.zh: 时代广场的大部分地方都空了，但几乎没有企业愿意填补进来。

sentences.en: This became a problem for all the businesses that stuck it out.
sentences.zh: 这成了所有坚持下来的企业的一个问题。

sentences.en: A handful of hotels and theaters who made it through the bad times.
sentences.zh: 少数熬过艰难时期的酒店和剧院。

sentences.en: And, of course, the New York Times.
And that brings us to the second ingredient in Times Square's transformation, from den of vice to big, bright, tourist hub.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了时代广场转型的第二个要素，从藏污纳垢之地变成了宏伟、明亮、充满游客的中心。

sentences.en: Sulzberger, Jr., son of the paper's publisher and heir to the title, had a vested interest in making the neighborhood shine again.
sentences.zh: 苏尔茨贝格，该报出版商的儿子兼头衔继承人，切身希望让这个街区重新焕发光彩。

sentences.en: Some people were turning down jobs at the paper because they didn't want to work in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 有些人拒绝了该报的工作机会，因为他们不想在这个街区工作。

sentences.en: And so Sulzberger led the charge for some of the area's property owners to take matters into their own hands.
sentences.zh: 于是苏尔茨贝格带头让该地区的一些业主自己动手解决问题。

sentences.en: He set his sights on an urban planning tool that had been gaining popularity among the country's business leaders.
sentences.zh: 他盯准了一种在全国商界领袖中越来越受欢迎的城市规划工具。

sentences.en: It was a tool that could let a group of unelected property owners generate enough money to transform their neighborhood,
sentences.zh: 这是一个能让一群非选举产生的业主筹集到足够资金来改造他们街区的工具，

sentences.en: all while skirting some of democracy's red tape.
sentences.zh: 同时还能避开民主的一些繁文缛节。

sentences.en: The tool was called a business improvement district, or a bid.
sentences.zh: 这个工具被称为商业改进区，简称BID。

sentences.en: These are kind of like private organizations that are managing urban space.
sentences.zh: 这些有点像管理城市空间的私人组织。

sentences.en: This is Daniel Kudla, a sociologist who has written a lot about bids.
sentences.zh: 这位是丹尼尔·库德拉，一位撰写了大量关于商业改进区文章的社会学家。

sentences.en: Essentially, they're a group of business and or property owners within a designated geographical area
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们是指定地理区域内的一群企业或业主，

sentences.en: who end up paying an annual tax to supplement local services to their commercial district.
sentences.zh: 他们最终通过缴纳年度税款来补充其商业区的本地服务。

sentences.en: The concept of a bid first popped up in Toronto in 1970,
sentences.zh: 商业改进区的概念于1970年首次出现在多伦多，

sentences.en: when a group of downtown merchants had lost a lot of customers to nearby malls.
sentences.zh: 当时一群市中心商家的大量顾客被附近的购物中心抢走了。

sentences.en: To remedy this classic suburban-era story,
sentences.zh: 为了弥补这个典型的城郊时代的故事，

sentences.en: they asked the council to make it mandatory for all downtown shops
sentences.zh: 他们要求市议会强制所有市中心商店

sentences.en: to pay into some local beautification projects in an attempt to bring people back.
sentences.zh: 出资参与一些美化本地的项目，以此试图把人吸引回来。

sentences.en: They put up some extra streetlights, some nice signs and banners,
sentences.zh: 他们安装了额外的路灯、漂亮的标牌和横幅，

sentences.en: and they saw a bump in customers.
sentences.zh: 并且他们发现顾客数量有所增加。

sentences.en: From there, bids spread across North America.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，商业改进区在北美各地传播开来。

sentences.en: The rules around them varied from city to city and state to state.
sentences.zh: 各城市和各州关于商业改进区的规则各不相同。

sentences.en: But in New York, for example,
all you needed was a simple majority of property owners to vote to approve a bid.
sentences.zh: 你只需要获得简单多数的业主投票批准建立商业改进区即可。

sentences.en: And then every property owner in the area had to pay in.
sentences.zh: 然后该地区的每个业主都必须出资。

sentences.en: The owners could then pass the cost on to renters.
sentences.zh: 业主随后可以将成本转嫁给租户。

sentences.en: The bid would then pool all that money
sentences.zh: 商业改进区随后会汇集所有这些资金

sentences.en: and spend it on what they or their chosen staff thought would help the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 并将其花在他们或他们挑选的工作人员认为对街区有帮助的事情上。

sentences.en: So this can be anything from hiring private security,
sentences.zh: 所以这可以是任何事情，从雇佣私人保安、

sentences.en: or even just marketing, promoting, branding the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 甚至只是营销、推广、打造街区品牌。

sentences.en: The city technically had to approve bids' formation and budgets.
sentences.zh: 按技术规定，城市必须批准商业改进区的成立和预算。

sentences.en: But after that, the bid would be in charge.
sentences.zh: 但在此之后，商业改进区将负责掌管。

sentences.en: Sulzberger saw what bids had done for other cities and neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 苏尔茨贝格看到了商业改进区为其他城市和街区所做出的改变。

sentences.en: And he figured that a bid might just finally be the solution
sentences.zh: 他认为商业改进区可能最终会成为解决方案，

sentences.en: to the city's drawn-out cleanup efforts.
sentences.zh: 来解决该市旷日持久的清理工作。

sentences.en: So he rallied the property owners.
It's certainly going to be the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这肯定会有《纽约时报》的参与。

sentences.en: It's certainly going to be the theater owners.
sentences.zh: 这肯定会有剧院业主的参与。

sentences.en: It's certainly going to be the retailers.
sentences.zh: 这肯定会有零售商的参与。

sentences.en: They want to have an impact and help shape the new Times Square.
sentences.zh: 他们希望产生影响，并帮助塑造崭新的时代广场。

sentences.en: In 1992, the majority voted to create a bid.
sentences.zh: 1992年，多数人投票决定创建一个商业改进区。

sentences.en: They got their approval from the city, and it was official.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了市政府的批准，这正式成立了。

sentences.en: The brand-new Times Square bid started collecting their fees
sentences.zh: 崭新的时代广场商业改进区开始收取费用，

sentences.en: and began the work of making something from nothing.
sentences.zh: 并开始着手无中生有地创造事物的工作。

sentences.en: Remember, at this point, Times Square was pretty empty.
sentences.zh: 记住，此时的时代广场相当空旷。

sentences.en: So the bid's first mission was to make sure their neighborhood
sentences.zh: 所以商业改进区的首要任务是确保他们的街区

sentences.en: was appealing enough to bring people back in for a wholesome brand of fun.
sentences.zh: 极具吸引力，能够把人们重新吸引回来，享受健康的乐趣。

sentences.en: And it was really important to start sending the message of change,
sentences.zh: 传递变革的信息真的非常重要，

sentences.en: that Times Square was going to be a new place.
sentences.zh: 即时代广场将成为一个新的地方。

sentences.en: It was cleared of, you know, the commercial sex.
sentences.zh: 这里清除了，你知道的，商业性色情服务。

sentences.en: And so they needed to promote Times Square
sentences.zh: 因此，他们需要将时代广场推广为

sentences.en: as a healthy place for people to come back to.
sentences.zh: 一个适合人们回归的健康场所。

sentences.en: Over the next year, the Business Improvement District got to work.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的里一年里，商业改进区投入了工作。

sentences.en: They employed a brigade of unarmed security officers.
sentences.zh: 他们雇佣了一支由手无寸铁的保安人员组成的队伍。

sentences.en: They hired street sweepers to pick up trash,
sentences.zh: 他们雇用了街道清扫工来捡垃圾，

sentences.en: stashing all their brooms in an empty theater.
sentences.zh: 把所有的扫帚都藏在一家空剧院里。

sentences.en: And they put on big public events,
sentences.zh: 他们举办了盛大的公共活动，

sentences.en: highlighting things Times Square was known for in its golden years.
sentences.zh: 突出展示时代广场在其黄金时代闻名的那些事物。
因此，从商业改进区的成立开始，

sentences.en: we tried to celebrate each one of those in a unique way.
sentences.zh: 我们试图以独特的方式庆祝其中的每一个项目。

sentences.en: the current president of Times Square's Business Improvement District,
sentences.zh: 时代广场商业改进区现任总裁，

sentences.en: which is now called the Times Square Alliance.
sentences.zh: 该组织现在被称为时代广场联盟。

sentences.en: He wasn't part of the group at that time,
sentences.zh: 他当时并不是该群体的一员，

sentences.en: but he knows a lot about its history.
sentences.zh: 但他对这段历史了解颇多。

sentences.en: We started with a taste of Times Square,
sentences.zh: 我们从“时代广场品味”活动开始，
邀请人们来到时代广场，

sentences.en: for a taste of some of these famous restaurants.
sentences.zh: 品尝其中一些著名餐厅的美食。

sentences.en: The Times Square bid also put on an event called Broadway on Broadway,
sentences.zh: 时代广场商业改进区还举办了一场名为“百老汇在百老汇”的活动，

sentences.en: closing down the street and putting on a big show
sentences.zh: 封闭街道并上演了一场大型演出，

sentences.en: of famous songs from musical theater.
sentences.zh: 表演音乐剧中的著名歌曲。

sentences.en: And that was the symbol that Times Square is family-friendly.
sentences.zh: 这就是时代广场适合家庭的象征。

sentences.en: But alongside all these efforts to reshape their neighborhood's image,
sentences.zh: 但除了所有这些重塑街区形象的努力之外，

sentences.en: the Times Square bid had something even bigger planned.
sentences.zh: 时代广场商业改进区还计划了更宏大的事情。

sentences.en: It was an event that was meant to convince the world
sentences.zh: 这是一项旨在说服全世界的活动，

sentences.en: that Times Square was exactly where they wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 即时代广场正是他们想要去的地方。

sentences.en: And what better way to do that
sentences.zh: 还有什么比这更好的方法呢，

sentences.en: than by hearkening back to another famed local tradition
sentences.zh: 那就是回溯另一项著名的当地传统，

sentences.en: and giving people the most rockin' New Year's Eve they'd ever seen.
sentences.zh: 并为人们带来他们见过的最震撼的除夕夜。

sentences.en: Times Square, this is the place where it all happens.
sentences.zh: 时代广场，这就是一切发生的地方。
他们难道不是快乐的人吗？

sentences.en: And it stretches way up and way down the whole square.
sentences.zh: 它一直延伸到整个广场的上方和下方。

sentences.en: In the porn years, the annual event had been a bit underwhelming.
sentences.zh: 在色情年代，这项年度活动有点平淡无奇。

sentences.en: People standing around in the cold,
watching more or less the same old ball drop.
sentences.zh: 看着大同小异的旧球体落下。

sentences.en: But all that changed for New Year's 1993,
sentences.zh: 但这一切在1993年跨年夜发生了改变，

sentences.en: when the Times Square bid overhauled the annual extravaganza.
sentences.zh: 当时时代广场商业改进区彻底翻新了年度盛会。
时代广场，看起来真不错。
他们重新设计了那个球。
他们正在看着球体移动。

sentences.en: There's a big 300-watt bulb at the top
sentences.zh: 顶部有一个300瓦的大灯泡，

sentences.en: and another one at the bottom.

sentences.zh: 他们把它变成了一场表演。

sentences.en: They were presenting the essence of entertainment,
sentences.zh: 他们在展现娱乐的精髓、

sentences.en: of joy, of gathering together to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 快乐的精髓，以及聚集在一起庆祝的精髓。

sentences.en: You know, they made it even more than what it was to begin with.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们让它超越了最初的意义。

sentences.en: fireworks lit up Times Square, dazzling visitors.
sentences.zh: 烟花照亮了时代广场，令游客眼花缭乱。

sentences.en: hand-tossed invisibly from the buildings above by volunteers.
sentences.zh: 由志愿者从上方建筑物隐蔽处用手抛撒下来。
五颜六色的纸张浸润了天空，

sentences.en: making the whole of Times Square this idyllic urban snow globe.
sentences.zh: 使整个时代广场变成了这个田园诗般的城市雪景球。

sentences.en: It might seem like an age-old tradition,
sentences.zh: 这可能看起来像是一个古老的传统，

sentences.en: Even Dick Clark gave a shout-out to the bid
sentences.zh: 就连迪克·克拉克也对商业改进区
以及他们创造的场景大加赞赏。
商业改进区将其变得神奇，
将其变成了一场视觉盛宴。

sentences.en: They spared no expense in doing that.
because the point of it wasn't to turn a profit.
sentences.zh: 因为这的重点不是为了盈利。

sentences.en: It was important for the Alliance
sentences.zh: 对联盟来说，重要的事情

sentences.en: not to make this the most profitable event of the year.
sentences.zh: 不是把这变成一年中最赚钱的活动。

sentences.en: It was to make this a civic event
sentences.zh: 而是将其办成一个公民活动，

sentences.en: that we produce and deliver free to the entire world.
sentences.zh: 由我们制作并免费呈献给全世界。

sentences.en: After all the work they'd done all year,
sentences.zh: 在他们一整年所做的工作之后，

sentences.en: the street sweeping, the patrolling, the events,
sentences.zh: 清扫街道、巡逻、举办活动，

sentences.en: the Times Square bid wanted all eyes on the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 时代广场商业改进区希望所有目光都聚焦在这个街区。

sentences.en: And they got what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们得到了他们想要的结果。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, when we welcomed the world there,
sentences.zh: 在跨年夜，当我们把世界各地的人们迎到那里时，

sentences.en: the world sees a cleaner, safer, family-friendly Times Square.
sentences.zh: 世界看到的是一个更干净、更安全、适合家庭的时代广场。

sentences.en: This image of a more approachable Times Square
sentences.zh: 这种更加平易近人的时代广场形象

sentences.en: More people started coming into the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人开始来到这个街区。

sentences.en: Add to that some hefty tax breaks.
sentences.zh: 再加上一些巨额税收减免。

sentences.en: And new restaurants, shops, offices, and theaters
sentences.zh: 新的餐厅、商店、办公室和剧院

sentences.en: moved into spaces that had been sitting empty.
sentences.zh: 搬进了原本一直空置的场地。

sentences.en: Even Disney opened a massive store and theater
sentences.zh: 甚至迪士尼也在时代广场正中央

sentences.en: right in the middle of Times Square.
sentences.zh: 开了一家巨大的商店和剧院。

sentences.en: By 1998, the neighborhood had been completely transformed,
sentences.zh: 到1998年，这个街区已经彻底焕然一新，

sentences.en: with the New York Times saying that Times Square was

sentences.zh: 可以说是最炙手可热的13英亩土地

sentences.en: of commercial property in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上商业地产的佼佼者。

sentences.en: The transformation of Times Square from its gritty past
sentences.zh: 时代广场从曾经肮脏的过去

sentences.en: to its shiny new future was in large part
sentences.zh: 到如今焕然一新的未来，很大程度上

sentences.en: thanks to the savvy and power of the Times Square bid.
sentences.zh: 要归功于时代广场商业改善区的精明强干。

sentences.en: Within just a few years, the group managed to do
sentences.zh: 在短短几年内，该组织成功做到了

sentences.en: had been failing to do for decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年来一直未能做到的事情。

sentences.en: It returned Times Square to something like its former glory.
sentences.zh: 它让时代广场恢复了往日的某种辉煌。
